device.description: 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 12-bit parallel interface (CS, WE, REG, LDAC), internal programmable reference, programmable settling time and power down

registers.name: HOLD
registers.note: DAC holding latch (REG = 0); power-on reset puts the internal latches to zero (p.11)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; loaded from the holding latch while LDAC is low (p.11)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: control register (REG = 1): D4 D3 REF1 REF0 (00/11 external, 01 1.024 V, 10 2.048 V), D1 PWR, D0 SPD, others don't care; defaults 0 (p.12)

commands.name: Write DAC holding latch (REG = 0)
commands.note: REG low: D11-D0 latched into the holding latch on the WE rising edge (p.11)

commands.name: Write control register (REG = 1)
commands.note: REG high: D11-D0 to the control register (p.11-12)

protocol.note: write-only parallel port: with CS low, data and REG are latched on the WE rising edge (Figure 1, p.11); REG selects the holding latch or the control register

ldac.note: LDAC low updates the DAC from the holding latch; asynchronous, may be held low (p.11)

notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 buffer), REF input/output and the internal reference (CTRL.REF stored only); SPD / PWR affect the analog side only
the device has no read-back: the parallel port is write-only (no RD pin)
digital input timing requirements tsu(CS-WE), tsu(D), tsu(R), th(DR), tsu(WE-LD), twH(WE), tw(LD) (p.6)
variants: tlv5639.pdf covers TLV5639C and TLV5639I; DW and PW share one pinout.
